title: Malta Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Malta study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Malta study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Acceptance from a recognized Maltese institution; Proof of funds and tuition plan; Passport and forms; Insurance. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Malta from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Malta is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Malta study visa?
faqs.answer: English programmes commonly need IELTS or equivalent; some accept MOI.

faqs.question: Can I study in Malta with low marks?
faqs.answer: Foundation and private pathways exist — we check recognition and visa risk honestly.

faqs.question: How long does Malta student visa take from Pakistan?
What documents are needed for Malta student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Acceptance letter; Funds; Academics; Insurance; Housing.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Malta?
faqs.answer: Student work rights depend on permit type — verify before counting on wages.

faqs.question: How to apply for Malta study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Malta study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Malta student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.
